title: Emitter index row
description: One place in Chromium that produces an observable value. The Chromium-side half of the map; joins many-to-many with the surface ledger.

line.description: Line at the pinned Chromium revision. Advisory — symbol is authoritative.

symbol.description: Function, method or constant that returns the value.

is_source_of_truth.description: True when this is where the value originates rather than somewhere it passes through. Under axiom A1 patches target sources of truth; a false value here means the real emitter is further down and must be found.

surfaces.description: Surface ledger ids this emitter produces.
